goal:
This is a JUNO-like liquid-scintillator detector world, in the spirit of the Jiangmen Underground Neutrino Observatory: a large underground scintillator detector whose physics (the neutrino mass ordering from reactor antineutrinos) rests on reconstructing per-event visible energy, vertex and time from the light a charged particle leaves in the scintillator — prompt Cherenkov light plus delayed scintillation light — collected by 17612 20-inch PMTs on a sphere of R = 19.37 m. Your job: reconstruct per-event energy, vertex and time from the digitized PMT waveforms — drive energy_res DOWN (lower is better; ties broken by vertex_res_cm, then timing_res_ns) while keeping the prediction contract valid. The task package benchmarks/electron_full/ carries the waveforms, the labeled train/val calibration splits, the instrument files (channel positions, PMT production-test nominal specifications) and the scorer. Every channel that pulsed in the window is digitized (zero-suppressed full readout; silent channels absent; wf_offsets/adc_pmt_ids map rows; t_run_s timestamps events in seconds from run start and nothing is guaranteed stationary). The editable surface is src/ only; the solver contract is `python3 src/solve.py --data <split-dir> --train <split-dir> --out <pred.npz>` writing E_rec, x_rec, y_rec, z_rec, t0_rec (t0 measured from window start; sample 0 = trigger time - 300 ns) — and it must also run on the test split, which carries no truth.

Calibration on this population: the shipped baseline (src/solve.py, charge-centroid) scores energy_res~0.112, vertex_res_cm~584, timing_res_ns~5.9 on val (~0.123 / 627 cm / 6.1 ns on test). The SANITY floors (energy_res >= 0.5%, vertex >= 3 cm, timing >= 0.3 ns) reject val-truth copying; the judged score is the harness's held-out test replay, which a val-truth-dependent solver cannot game.
gate_block:
Only modify files under src/. The harness runs, in order:
  - bash scripts/check_verify.sh   (VERIFY gate: the solver runs on val and emits a well-formed, in-range prediction npz)
  - bash scripts/bench.sh          (objective: energy_res on the labeled val split, lower is better; also emits the SANITY gate token)
A change is accepted only if VERIFY=PASS and SANITY=PASS; among accepted changes, lower energy_res wins, ties broken by vertex_res_cm then timing_res_ns. At the exit the harness re-runs your final solver on the held-out test split (no truth in-container) and scores it against truth you never see — dry-run on the test split yourself to be sure it runs there. python3 is 3.9 with numpy 2.0 only; /scratch is free space for generated datasets, fits and predictions. Both scripts can be run mid-research to measure progress; the harness re-measures from a pristine checkout of your final src/ at the exit.
